qualifier: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation
name: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor activation and signaling
rationale: All members concern ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking or downstream excitatory/excitotoxic effects, and unlike the confusables (plasticity/CREB/memory or AMPA clustering) the theme spans kainate, AMPA and NMDA receptor activation itself.

core: Protein glycosylation of proteoglycans and Notch
qualifier: heparan sulfate plus Notch/TSR O-fucose and O-glucose
name: Heparan sulfate synthesis and Notch O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation
rationale: Members are Golgi/ER glycan synthesis on proteins, combining heparan sulfate/heparin chain synthesis (EXT1/2) with O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation of Notch and TSR proteins, which separates it from chondroitin/keratan, N-glycan and Notch-patterning confusables.

core: Proteasomal degradation in antitumor T-cell immunity
name: Proteasome assembly and PD-L1 turnover in antitumor immunity
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation with PD-L1 glycosylation/degradation and CD8 T-cell antitumor responses, whereas confusables centre on MHC-I peptide loading or HIV Nef/Vpu degradation.

core: Enteric neural development and visceral smooth muscle motility
name: RET/endothelin enteric neural development and visceral smooth muscle motility
rationale: Members cover enteric neural crest development via RET/GDNF and endothelin plus gut and urinary smooth muscle motility, distinguishing it from vascular endothelin, reproductive smooth muscle and muscle relaxation confusables.

qualifier: all repair modes plus telomere maintenance
name: Pan-pathway DNA repair and telomere maintenance
rationale: Members span base excision, nucleotide excision, mismatch, translesion, double-strand break repair and telomere maintenance, a far broader repair repertoire than the replication, chromatin assembly or telomerase-RNA confusables.

qualifier: via VEGF production and VEGFR signaling
name: Positive regulation of sprouting angiogenesis via VEGF production
rationale: All members positively drive endothelial sprouting through growth factor (VEGF, TGF-beta2) production and VEGFR signaling, unlike confusables centred on Tie2, endothelial apoptosis or negative regulation.

qualifier: laminin, collagen trimer and anchoring fibril
name: Basement membrane laminin, collagen and anchoring fibril organization
rationale: Members concern basement membrane construction via laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerization and anchoring fibrils, unlike fibrillar/elastic ECM, collagen crosslinking or VWF confusables.

name: Aggresome formation and autophagic clearance of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members cover misfolded-protein response, aggresome assembly/perinuclear localization and aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, versus confusables emphasizing ERAD, ubiquitin ligases, stress granules or chaperone folding.

qualifier: RUNX1-centred myeloid and immune signaling genes
name: RUNX1-centred transcription of myeloid differentiation and immune signaling genes
rationale: All members are RUNX1/2/3-dependent transcriptional programs for myeloid differentiation, BCR and interleukin signaling genes, while confusables describe granulocyte/monocyte differentiation without RUNX control.

qualifier: ERAD regulation, reticulophagy and lysosomal autophagy
name: Misfolded protein triage via ERAD, aggrephagy and lysosomal autophagy
rationale: Members handle misfolded proteins through ERAD regulation, unfolding, inclusion/aggresome control, reticulophagy, aggrephagy and chaperone-mediated/microautophagy, distinguishing it from aggresome-only, stress-granule and ribosome quality-control confusables.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF/RAS mutants and integrin adaptors
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF mutants and integrin adaptors
rationale: Members are RAF-MAP2K-MAPK activation by BRAF/RAF1/RAS mutants and fusions plus integrin GRB2:SOS/p130Cas linkage, which the MRAS/RAF, negative-feedback and Rap1 confusables lack.

name: Hemidesmosome assembly and basement membrane laminin-integrin anchorage
rationale: Members cover laminin/collagen basement membrane and integrin interactions together with hemidesmosome assembly, which distinguishes it from collagen/elastic fibre, dystroglycan and desmosome confusables.

name: Proteasome assembly and MHC class I antigen processing
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation with MHC-I peptide loading, ER transport and cross-presentation, unlike broader MHC-II, Nef/Vpu or PD-L1 confusables.

qualifier: nephron patterning and nephric duct formation
name: Nephron patterning and nephric duct development
rationale: Members describe nephron segment morphogenesis (comma/S-shaped bodies, tubules, loop of Henle) and nephric/mesonephric duct formation from intermediate mesoderm, while confusables focus on ureteric bud branching, kidney size and growth restraint.

name: Regulation of bone and dentin matrix mineralization
rationale: Members regulate bone and dentin mineralization (with matrix protein phosphorylation and chondrocyte development), unlike enamel, osteoclast/IGF or FGF23-Klotho phosphate confusables.

name: Endosomal nucleic-acid-sensing TLR trafficking and signaling
rationale: All members concern TLR3/7/8/9 trafficking (UNC93B1), regulation and downstream IRF5 activation, whereas confusables are type I interferon responses and cytosolic RNA/DNA sensing.

core: Membrane lipid and Rab identity at ER-Golgi
qualifier: non-vesicular lipid transfer and Rab prenylation
name: Intermembrane lipid transfer and Rab GTPase prenylation/activation
rationale: Members combine ER-Golgi phospholipid/glycolipid transfer with Rab geranylgeranylation and GEF activation; the glycolipid transfer separates it from Wnt secretion and the Rab prenylation from lipid hydrolysis, vesicle traffic and flippase confusables.

name: Photoreceptor outer segment morphogenesis and maintenance
rationale: Members concern photoreceptor/cone morphogenesis, outer segment organization and long-term maintenance, unlike retinal neuron differentiation or general ciliary transport confusables.

name: Optic cup-derived eye morphogenesis and pigmentation
rationale: Members cover optic cup, retina and iris morphogenesis and eye pigmentation, while confusables concern ear, craniofacial or lens/cornea development.

name: mRNA polyadenylation and deadenylation-linked mRNA decay
rationale: Members span poly(A) addition and 3'-end processing through deadenylation, decapping and 5'-3' decay, unlike ARE-binding/miRNA confusables (no polyadenylation) and histone mRNA processing (no deadenylation).

name: Mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation control
rationale: Members regulate proliferation and differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells and osteoblasts (with Wnt signaling), unlike ossification/tendon, BMP/SMAD or mineralization confusables.

qualifier: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases with lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors
name: 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase and branched-chain amino acid catabolism with cofactors
rationale: Members are PDH/OGDH/BCKDH/OADH reactions, branched-chain and lysine catabolism and their lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors, unlike TCA/Fe-S, fatty acid oxidation or serine/B6 confusables.

name: Mevalonate-isoprenoid and post-lanosterol cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: All members are steps of sterol synthesis from mevalonate/isoprenoids through lanosterol and the Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell routes, unlike the cytochrome P450 disease, VLCFA or fatty acid elongation confusables.

name: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I/III transcription and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members cover Pol I rRNA and Pol III 5S/tRNA transcription, its chromatin regulation, rRNA processing and MYC growth programs, unlike splicing, RNA modification/decay or translation initiation confusables.

core: Kinase control of hepatic metabolic regulators
name: Glucagon-PKA and AMPK phosphorylation of hepatic metabolic regulators
rationale: All members are inhibitory phosphorylation of metabolic factors such as ChREBP by glucagon-activated PKA or AMPK, unlike glycogen, ChREBP-activation or insulin-secretion confusables.
